title: Machine learning on mass spectrometry selects prostate cancer risk biomarkers
summary: MS-GUIDE screened 48 candidate protein markers by parallel reaction monitoring in 78 patients, and machine-learning models ranked by 50-fold bootstrapped cross-validation selected fibronectin and vitronectin. In an independent cohort of 263 patients, clinical-grade ELISAs gave a risk score about 10% better than PSA alone, PSA plus Gleason or NCCN score for biochemical recurrence. Retrospective with a modest gain; the specific algorithm was not read.
ai_technology: Machine-learning models ranking candidate protein biomarkers (50-fold bootstrapped cross-validation)
organization: SIB Swiss Institute of Bioinformatics; ETH Zurich; Institute of Translational Medicine
